+def load_image_bytes(ref: str | None) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load an image a user may have referenced, without ever making an HTTP
+    request. Accepts data: URLs, storage-host URLs and relative storage paths;
+    any other URL (SSRF risk) yields None."""
+    import base64
+    import re
+
+    if not ref:
+        return None
+    if ref.startswith("data:image"):
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(ref.split(",", 1)[1])
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and ref.startswith(host + "/"):
+        key = ref[len(host) + 1:]
+    elif re.match(r"^([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:|//|\\)", ref):
+        return None
+    else:
+        key = ref.lstrip("/")
+    key = key.split("?", 1)[0]
+    if not key:
+        return None
+    return storage.download_image(key)

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+import pytest
+from PIL import Image
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _png() -> bytes:
+    buf = io.BytesIO()
+    Image.new("RGB", (4, 4), (255, 0, 0)).save(buf, format="PNG")
+    return buf.getvalue()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def no_http(monkeypatch):
+    import requests
+
+    calls = []
+
+    def fake(*a, **k):
+        calls.append(a)
+        raise AssertionError(f"backend made an HTTP request: {a}")
+
+    for name in ("get", "post", "request"):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(requests, name, fake)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(requests.Session, "request", lambda *a, **k: fake(*a))
+    return calls
+
+
+def _make_episode_with_cut(client, h, image_path):
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "E", "project_id": p["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    assert e.status_code == 200, e.text
+    eid = e.json()["id"]
+    c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": 1, "script": ""})
+    assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{c.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return eid
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+    "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health",
+    "https://10.0.0.5/secret.png",
+    "ftp://internal/x.png",
+    "//internal/x.png",
+])
+def test_export_never_requests_user_urls(client, no_http, url):
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid = _make_episode_with_cut(client, h, url)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert no_http == []
+
+
+def test_load_image_bytes_refuses_foreign_urls(no_http):
+    from app.services.storage import load_image_bytes
+
+    for url in ["http://169.254.169.254/x", "https://example.com/a.png", "file:///etc/passwd", "//host/x"]:
+        assert load_image_bytes(url) is None
+    assert no_http == []
+
+
+def test_ai_and_board_downloaders_never_request_urls(no_http):
+    from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+    from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+
+    assert BaseAIService()._download_image("http://10.0.0.1/x.png") is None
+    assert download_image("http://10.0.0.1/x.png") is None
+    assert no_http == []
+
+
+def test_data_urls_and_storage_images_still_work(client, no_http):
+    from app.core.config import settings
+    from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+    from app.services.storage import load_image_bytes, storage
+
+    png = _png()
+    data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode()
+    assert load_image_bytes(data_url) == png
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(png, schema="test", identifier="ssrf")
+    assert load_image_bytes(key) == png
+    assert load_image_bytes(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}") == png
+    assert download_image(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}") is not None
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid = _make_episode_with_cut(client, h, key)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as z:
+        assert len(z.namelist()) == 1
+        assert z.read(z.namelist()[0]) == png
+
+
+def _episode(client, h):
+    p = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()
+    e = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "E", "project_id": p["id"], "episode_order": 1})
+    return e.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _cut(client, h, eid, order, image_path):
+    c = client.post("/api/v1/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": eid, "cut_order": order, "script": ""})
+    assert c.status_code == 200, c.text
+    if image_path:
+        r = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{c.json()['id']}", headers=h, json={"image_path": image_path})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+
+def _mixed(client, h):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    key = storage.upload_image(_png(), schema="test", identifier="missing")
+    eid = _episode(client, h)
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 1, key)
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 2, None)  # no image yet
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 3, "http://169.254.169.254/x.png")  # refused
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 4, "test/missing/nope.png")  # not in storage
+    return eid, key
+
+
+def test_zip_export_lists_missing_cuts(client, no_http):
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid, _ = _mixed(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as z:
+        assert z.read("missing.txt").decode().split("\n") == ["2", "3", "4", ""]
+        assert len(z.namelist()) == 2
+
+
+def test_strip_export_lists_missing_cuts(client, no_http):
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid, _ = _mixed(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+
+
+def test_strip_export_counts_undecodable_image_as_missing(client):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    good = storage.upload_image(_png(), schema="test", identifier="ok")
+    bad = storage.upload_image(b"not an image", schema="test", identifier="bad")
+    eid = _episode(client, h)
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 1, good)
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 2, bad)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fmt", ["zip", "webtoon"])
+def test_nothing_missing_means_no_marker(client, fmt):
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    eid = _episode(client, h)
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 1, storage.upload_image(_png(), schema="test", identifier="a"))
+    _cut(client, h, eid, 2, storage.upload_image(_png(), schema="test", identifier="b"))
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{eid}/export?format={fmt}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert "X-Missing-Cuts" not in r.headers
+    if fmt == "zip":
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(r.content)) as z:
+            assert "missing.txt" not in z.namelist()
